mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.member_id AS commenterId, m.nickname AS commenterNickname, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM comment c INNER JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.id ASC
SELECT c.id, c.member_id AS commenterId, m.nickname AS commenterNickname, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM comment c INNER JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment ( post_id, member_id, content, created_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, NOW() )
